excerpt.zh: 属于里甘商业交易所的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 袭击者的来路不明。

texts.en: The starbase belonging to the Riggan Commerce Exchange has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. Forces from an unidentified aggressor have made certain of that.
